description.zh: 短版命名空间ID，不需要带上region；不超过20个字符，仅允许小写英文字母和数字。
description.en: The short ID of the namespace. You do not need to specify a region ID. The value of this parameter can be up to 20 characters in length and can contain only lowercase letters and digits.

description.zh: 命名空间ID。默认命名空间不可查询、更改或删除。
description.en: The ID of the namespace. The information about the default namespace cannot be queried or modified. The default namespace cannot be deleted.

title.zh: 查询命名空间详细信息

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sae describe-namespace --namespace-id cn-beijing:test --name-space-short-id test --region cn-hangzhou
